posts.text: Last weekend, I had the opportunity to attend Canada's largest Hackathon - Hack the North. This was my first time attending Hack the North, but I quickly adapted to the fast-paced environment. Despite not having a concrete idea until Friday midnight, I was dedicated to winning at all costs. With zero hours of sleep and a Red Bull, I managed to help my team finish implementing one of my most polished hackathon projects yet - EcoRewards. And guess what... WE WON! 🎉 🏆🎉 My team won 1st place in the
Very honoured to be part of this winning hackathon team as the core developer! We had so much synergy, go equipotentials!
